reviews.title: Cancelled after first day
reviews.text:
First issue was that the app offered a 3-day free trial, but as soon as I hit subscribe, my account was charged for the annual subscription amount. 
Second issue, my alarm went off as planned on the first morning, but the object I was supposed to take a picture of was a mouse… I certainly don’t have any mice in my house to locate and snap a pic of at 5:30am. I had high hopes for this app but what a joke.

reviews.title: App just doesnt work
reviews.text:
So i heard about this on app on tiktok and have always been a heavy sleeper so i thought it was worth a shot. I downloaded it, signed up for the free trial and started getting it all set up. I made sure it was set on day one….and ended up 30 minutes late because the alarm never went off. So i double checked everything, made sure it was on AM and not PM, made sure my wake up task was set up to take a picture of my front door, gave it all the permission it asked for. The next morning, my dogs woke me up about 5 minutes before my alarm went off, so i waited for the alarm to go off. All i got was a silent notification on my phone “your alarm is going off” so i went to the app THEN my alarm started going off. I was already at my front door from letting the dogs out, so i took the picture, and the app said it wasnt my fromt door. So i tried it again-same
Thing. The app just doesnt work. It doesn’t recognize when you meet silence criteria.

reviews.title: Best alarm i’ve tried yet!
reviews.text: This alarm app is an absolute game changer. I used to be the king of hitting snooze and falling right back asleep, but this app does NOT let that happen. It literally won’t stop until you’re fully awake and I mean actually awake. The challenges it makes you complete (like solving problems, scanning something in another room, or doing small tasks) force your brain to turn on instead of just blindly tapping snooze!

reviews.title: My snooze button is in a coffin
reviews.text:
I'm not exaggerating when I say I've been late to everything in my life for the past 4 years. Class. Work. Flights. My own birthday dinner once. I genuinely thought something was wrong with me.
Downloaded this app as a joke because my friend roasted me for having 14 alarms on my phone. Set the steps mission thinking "how hard can walking be at 6am." Brother. I was stumbling around my apartment like a zombie doing laps around my kitchen island at dawn. But by the time I hit the step count I was fully conscious and honestly kind of mad about it.
The worst part? It works. Like annoyingly well. I can't even be dramatic about oversleeping anymore because it hasn't happened in 2 weeks. My whole personality was being the late friend and now I have nothing.
Anyway 5 stars. I'm early to things now and I don't know what to do with all this extra time. Might start making breakfast like some kind of functioning adult.
